pr.title: fix(security): reject weak default secrets
pr.body:
## Problem
.env.example and install.sh expose weak placeholder or development secret values that can be copied or preserved into local env files.

## Fix
- Replace weak .env.example values with explicit CHANGE_ME placeholders and generation comments.
- Teach install.sh to treat known placeholder/dev values as unset and regenerate or prompt.
- Replace static local secret defaults with generated values.
- Add focused installer tests.

## Test Plan
- Validate Task Packet JSON and schema.
- Run focused installer secret tests.
- Run bash -n install.sh.
- Run git diff --check and pre-commit on changed files.
